{"parse":{"title":"2026–27 Liga II","pageid":83195406,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Liga II]] | season = 2026–27 | dates = 1 August 2026 – May 2027 | winners = | promoted = | relegated = | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = | total goals = | longest wins = | longest losses = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Liga II|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Liga II|2027–28]] | updated = 29 July 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Liga II''' (also known as '''Liga 2 Casa Pariurilor''' for sponsorship reasons) is the 87th season of [[Liga II]], the second tier of the [[Romanian football league system]], and the eleventh consecutive season held in a single series. The season is scheduled to begin on 1 August 2026. The competition calendar was approved by the executive committee of the [[Romanian Football Federation]] (FRF) on 26 May 2026, and the regular-season schedule was drawn on 22 July 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.frf.ro/competitii/competitii-masculin/liga-2-casa-pariurilor/au-fost-stabilite-meciurile-sezonului-regular-2026-2027-din-liga-2-casa-pariurilor/|title=Au fost stabilite meciurile sezonului regular 2026–2027 din Liga 2 Casa Pariurilor|language=ro|trans-title=The matches of the 2026–27 Liga II regular season have been established|publisher=frf.ro|date=22 July 2026|access-date=29 July 2026 }} The format has been maintained, with a regular season contested by twenty-two teams in a single [[round-robin tournament]]. The top six teams at the end of the regular season advance to the promotion play-offs. The first two teams in the play-offs will be promoted to [[2027–28 Liga I|Liga I]], while the third- and fourth-placed teams will play a promotion/relegation play-off against the 13th- and 14th-placed teams from [[2026–27 Liga I|Liga I]].{{cite web|url=https://liga2.prosport.ro/seria-1/frf-stabileste-acum-programul-meciurilor-noului-sezon-de-liga-2-editia-2026-2027-19393479|title=Programul meciurilor noului sezon de Liga 2, ediția 2026–2027|language=ro|trans-title=Match schedule for the new 2026–27 Liga II season|publisher=liga2.prosport.ro|date=22 July 2026|access-date=29 July 2026}} The remaining sixteen teams will compete in the relegation play-outs, divided into two groups. The last two teams from each group will be relegated to [[2026–27 Liga III|Liga III]]. Additionally, the sixth-placed teams from each play-out group will face each other in a play-off to decide the final team to be relegated. == Teams == A total of twenty-two teams contested the league, including fifteen from the previous season, two relegated from Liga I, and five promoted from Liga III. The participating clubs were admitted through the FRF certification or Liga I licensing procedures.{{cite web |url=https://www.frf.ro/recomandate/informare-privind-solutionarea-cererilor-de-acordare-a-certificatului-pentru-participarea-in-campionatul-national-liga-a-2-a-sezonul-2026-2027/|title=Informare privind soluționarea cererilor de acordare a Certificatului pentru participarea în Campionatul Național Liga a 2-a, sezonul 2026–2027|language=ro|trans-title=Information regarding certification for participation in the 2026–27 Liga II|publisher=frf.ro|date=14 July 2026|access-date=29 July 2026}} === Team changes === {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-2}} ;To Liga II '''Relegated from [[2025–26 Liga I|Liga I]] ''' * [[FC Metaloglobus București|Metaloglobus București]] – after one year in the top flight. * [[AFC Unirea Slobozia|Unirea Slobozia]] – after two years in the top flight.
